title: EC618 partition table
description: The flash-layout descriptor used to provision an EC618 firmware image.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of the partition-table descriptor.

xip-offset.description: The EC618 XIP mapping adds 0x800000 to raw flash addresses.

partitions.description: The partitions in ascending, contiguous flash order.

name.description: The unique NUL-free name stored in the anchor table (at most 15 UTF-8 bytes; checked by the loader).

type.description: The partition role stored in the anchor table.

offset.description: An optional externally constrained raw-flash offset. Omitted offsets are derived from the preceding partition.
